planning_notes: Uno wiring preserved exactly: HC-SR04 TRIG=D8, ECHO=D9; TM1637 CLK=D4, DIO=D5; LED=D13 (HIGH亮).

Ultrasonic device rules preserved: use timeout_us=25000 and supported distance range 2..400cm; on timeout/out-of-range set validity false while holding the previous distance internally; LED and display must be gated by ultrasonic_valid in the model so timeout is not converted into 0cm behavior.

Display rules preserved: distance in cm is computed from echo microseconds/58, then the model decides whether to display an integer centimeter (quantized with tolerance 1cm allowed) when ultrasonic_valid is true; LED threshold comparison uses measured distance (not display-quantized value) and is strict (<10cm => LED on; >=10cm => LED off).
Startup rules preserved: initial display must be blank and LED must be off; the ultrasonic_valid initial is false so gating in the model blanks the display until first valid measurement.

Sampling/latency requirement preserved by design intent: ultrasonic updates must occur at a control-period multiple (previous contract used sample_period_ms=65ms); bounded echo wait/timeout are handled within the ultrasonic device, while the model ensures updates (measurement + display transmission) appear within the 250ms bound after a sampling start interval of 60..160ms.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: HC-SR04 distance status LED: HIGH when valid measured distance < 10cm, else LOW (high level bright). Threshold uses measured distance, not display-quantized value.

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: HC-SR04 measured distance in cm; invalid/timeout/out-of-range must not be treated as 0 (validity is controlled separately). Distance uses echo_us/58, supports 2..400cm.

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: HC-SR04 validity: true only when echo captured within 25,000us timeout and computed distance lies in supported range 2..400cm.

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 display: show integer centimeters when ultrasonic_valid is true and keep display blank otherwise (startup blank). Leading zeros are not required.

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
使用 HC-SR04 + TM1637 + LED：显示距离，小于10cm LED（D13）亮
验收约定：目标板Uno；HC-SR04 TRIG=D8、ECHO=D9，TM1637 CLK=D4、DIO=D5，LED=D13，高电平亮。距离以cm为单位，回波微秒数除58；有效范围2..400cm，显示整数厘米（量化容差1cm，前导零或空白均可）。有效距离严格小于10cm时LED亮，等于或大于10cm时灭；阈值判断使用测量距离而非显示取整值。采样开始间隔60..160ms，变化250ms内反映（包含测量等待和显示传输）。每次等待回波必须有25000us超时；无回波、卡高或越界时显示空白且LED灭，恢复后继续响应。初始显示空白且LED灭；测量值和有效性必须区分，不得将超时当成0cm。原需求未指定的传感器及显示引脚采用上述公开接线，各组相同。
